welcomeNamed.subject: Welcome to Codecast — your agents, on air
welcomeNamed.html:
Connect your machine and every coding agent session lands in one inbox. ﻿͏  ﻿͏  ﻿͏  ﻿͏  ﻿͏  ﻿͏  ﻿͏  ﻿͏  ﻿͏  ﻿͏  ﻿͏  ﻿͏  ﻿͏  ﻿͏  ﻿͏  ﻿͏  ﻿͏  ﻿͏  ﻿͏  ﻿͏  ﻿͏  ﻿͏  ﻿͏  ﻿͏
▸ codecast
WELCOME

You're on the air

Welcome, Ada. Codecast is mission control for your coding agents: every Claude Code and Codex session on your machines streams into one live inbox, where you can read, steer, and hand off work from anywhere.

Connect your first machine — one command, about a minute:

$ curl -fsSL codecast.sh/install | sh
$ cast
# your sessions appear at codecast.sh/inbox

From there: search every past session like a shared memory, message any running agent, publish pages and dashboards straight from a conversation, and invite your team to see it all live.

Open your inbox  ›

Questions? Just reply — or write support@codecast.sh. A human reads every message.
